description_en: Creates an automatic stop policy for a specific Data Science Workshop (DSW) instance. When the conditions are met, the instance is automatically stopped. You can create only one automatic stop policy for an idle DSW instance. If the specific instance has an automatic stop policy, call DeleteIdleInstanceCuller to delete it first
description_zh: 创建指定实例的自动关机策略，满足条件时将自动停止DSW实例。一个DSW实例只支持创建一个闲置自动关机策略，如果指定实例已设定过闲置自动关机策略，请先调用DeleteIdleInstanceCuller将其删除
name: CreateIdleInstanceCuller

parameters.description_en: The instance ID. You can call [ListInstances](~~470439~~) to obtain the instance ID.
parameters.description_zh: 设定自动关机的实例ID。如何获取实例ID，请参见[ListInstances](~~470439~~)。
parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html to obtain the instance ID
parameters.help_zh: 设定自动关机的实例ID。如何获取实例ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/470439.html
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.description_en: The CPU utilization threshold. Unit: percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. If the CPU utilization of the instance is lower than this threshold, the instance is considered idle.
parameters.description_zh: CPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100，低于此值则认为实例当前处于闲置。
parameters.help_en: The CPU utilization threshold. Unit: percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. If the CPU utilization of the instance is lower than this threshold, the instance is considered idle
parameters.help_zh: CPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100，低于此值则认为实例当前处于闲置
parameters.name: cpu_percent_threshold

parameters.description_en: The GPU utilization threshold. Unit: percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter takes effect only if the instance is of the GPU instance type. If both CPU and GPU utilization is lower than the thresholds, the instance is considered idle.
parameters.description_zh: GPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100。如果实例为GPU类型，则此参数生效。CPU和GPU同时低于阈值则认为指定实例处于闲置。
parameters.help_en: The GPU utilization threshold. Unit: percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. This parameter takes effect only if the instance is of the GPU instance type. If both CPU and GPU utilization is lower than the thresholds, the instance is considered idle
parameters.help_zh: GPU使用率阈值，单位是百分比，取值1~100。如果实例为GPU类型，则此参数生效。CPU和GPU同时低于阈值则认为指定实例处于闲置
parameters.name: gpu_percent_threshold

parameters.description_en: The maximum time duration for which the instance is idle. Unit: minutes. If the time duration for which the instance is idle exceeds this value, the system automatically stops the instance.
parameters.description_zh: 闲置等待时间阈值，单位是分钟。如果闲置时长超过此值，将自动停止DSW实例。
parameters.help_en: The maximum time duration for which the instance is idle. Unit: minutes. If the time duration for which the instance is idle exceeds this value, the system automatically stops the instance
parameters.help_zh: 闲置等待时间阈值，单位是分钟。如果闲置时长超过此值，将自动停止DSW实例
parameters.name: max_idle_time_in_minutes
